card.text: The Lagoon is a star-forming H II region about 1,326 parsecs away. Its young NGC 6530 cluster shares the surrounding cloud complex.

sources.label: Wright et al. (2019), The Gaia-ESO Survey: Asymmetric expansion of the Lagoon Nebula cluster NGC 6530 from GES and Gaia DR2
